parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the front of the coffee machine used to control power or brewing functions.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main control interface for turning the machine on or off or starting the brewing process.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A secondary plastic button located near the base or handle area of the coffee machine.
parts.Functional_description: It may control additional functions such as warming or brewing strength.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: A glass container or carafe that holds the brewed coffee.
parts.Functional_description: It collects and stores the brewed coffee, designed to withstand heat and pressure from the brewing process.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed from the base for pouring and cleaning.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid that covers the coffee container or water reservoir.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents spills and helps maintain temperature during brewing.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated open for filling or cleaning.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the coffee machine made of durable plastic housing all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and encloses the internal mechanisms, providing structure and stability to the coffee machine.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed frame of the appliance.
